title: Akiyama Mizuki — A Moment Of Jest〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Good not-so-morning♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Just kidding. No one's gonna around in the day—>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Good morning.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? Yuki?! Wait...why?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What do you mean? Today is Sunday.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Right... I haven't been going to school much lately, so I honestly had no idea.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's still unusual to see you on Nightcord at this hour on a Sunday, though. Don't you have club activities?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No club activities today. That's why I'm studying at home.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm almost done, though, so I was thinking of doing some work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, okay. Um, is it urgent work, by any chance?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Great! I've been doing some research on my own after the doll exhibition the other day, so let me tell what I found♪>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What were you researching?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Exhibitions! It occurred to me that looking at works and stuff may be a good stimulus.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The doll exhibition helped me to see that looking at things like that can be quite good for inspiration.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Trick art, fashion design...oh! And a personal exhibition being held in a small gallery too! Everything seems pretty interesting!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I think it's something about abstract art?
It's really cool, in any case!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I glanced at the art and it was...how do I say this. It's not something you can easily describe in words. Seriously, you have to see it with your own eyes to—>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oops, sorry! That was too much info at once, huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That's not it...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Why do you care so much about me?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K promised to compose a song that will save me.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But neither you nor Enanan have any reason to care about me that much. So...why?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Why, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Don't be such a stranger. We're friends, aren't we?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Friends?
I thought we were only members of the same songmaking group?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Well, it's definitely hard to define our relationship with any of the usual youthful friendship tropes.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But both of us are quite alike.
In the sense that people around us refuse to recognize our true selves.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The way we're forced to act out a twisted version of ourselves, and how we struggle with that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What she's dealing with just feels so personal to me.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Don't worry about it. I'm doing this because I want to.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So you don't have to think too deeply into it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I see. I'll take your word for it, then.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm going back to work now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I got it! Oh, and make sure you also think about which exhibition we'll be going to next together, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And nowhere is not an acceptable answer!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'll think about it...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sounds like she doesn't mind going to another exhibition together, then. Excellent.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really hope Mafuyu finds what she's looking for soon.
